originalScreenshotsActuallyViewed.observation: Actually viewed: 960x540 menu shows full Penguintrack title, Play/Race Friends and all eight secondary menu choices, Controller and guest badge. Host card does not overlap the menu buttons. Footer guidance is legible; no connected ID is expected at this stage.

Actually viewed: snowy 3D track, penguin kart, track/medal/map/timer/speed HUD and controller guidance are visible. Side card shows controller icon, 1P connected and complete wrapped ID. Displayed speed is 44 km/h; the still alone does not prove motion.

Actually viewed: Paused title, Resume/Restart/Settings/Quit and ghost choices are fully visible. Expanded controller card with complete wrapped ID overlaps part of the background minimap while paused, but does not obscure any pause action or the player viewport center.

Actually viewed: complete connected ID and expanded card remain readable while Paused menu stays visible. Resume/Restart/Settings/Quit and ghost choices are unobscured. Background minimap is partly covered by the card; no gameplay motion claim is made from this still.
